text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Academic transcript of high school5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program)6.Letter of guardian’s guarantee For applicant under 18 years of ageLetter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).7.No Objection Letter(N.O.C.) from the pervious university if you are a transfer student A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the N.O.C. from original university.
